claim: New York Labor Law § 202-k (the 2008 "Broadcast Employees Freedom to Work Act") prohibits broadcasting-industry employers from requiring broadcast employees to refrain from obtaining employment after the conclusion of employment.
evidence: No broadcasting industry employer shall require, as a condition of obtaining or continuing employment, that any employee or applicant for employment refrain from obtaining employment with any other person or entity after the conclusion of employment with such employer.
